description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for building responses to 'live' modification commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages construction of command responses and events, providing builder methods for customization.

classes.name: AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Abstract base class for building responses for modification commands, providing extensibility for subclasses to define response and event creation logic.

methods.name: AbstractLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the builder with a command object, checking for nullity.

methods.name: withResponse
methods.description: Sets a function to create a command response as part of the answer.

methods.name: withoutResponse
methods.description: Indicates no response should be attached.

methods.name: withEvent
methods.description: Sets a function to create an event as part of the answer.

methods.name: withoutEvent
methods.description: Indicates no event should be attached.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a LiveCommandAnswer using the specified response and event creation functions.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for creating a CommandResponse.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for creating an Event.
